items.question: How often should I have my lawn mowed?
items.answer: During peak growing season, we recommend weekly mowing to maintain optimal lawn health and appearance. In slower growth periods, bi-weekly service may be sufficient.

items.question: Do you offer free estimates?
items.answer: Yes. We provide free, no-obligation estimates for all our services. Call us at (413) 551-9653 or request an estimate online.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes. Trimming Edge is licensed and insured to protect both our team and your property.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We proudly serve Huntington, Montgomery, Russell, and Westfield in Western Massachusetts.

items.question: Do you provide commercial landscaping services?
items.answer: Yes. We provide reliable commercial property maintenance for businesses, HOAs, and property managers.

items.question: What services does Trimming Edge offer?
items.answer: Our main services include lawn mowing and maintenance, landscape design and installation, tree and shrub care, seasonal cleanups, mulching and bed maintenance, and commercial landscaping.
